sAccuracy.Name: Pilot's Accuracy
sAccuracy.Text: <SkillValue>% probability of dealing maximum damage. Influenced by the enemy's mobility.

sCharm.Name: Pilot's Charisma
sCharm.Text: Positive reaction from others is increased by <SkillValue>%, along with the fee for completing missions.

sLeadership.Name: Leadership
sLeadership.Text: The pilot can command a total of <SkillValue> other ships and receive up to <SkillValue2>% of the experience earned by his or her subordinates.

sMobility.Name: Pilot's Mobility
sMobility.Text: <SkillValue>% probability of sustaining minimum damage. Influenced by the enemy's accuracy.

sTechnical.Name: Technology Skill
sTechnical.Text: Equipment wears out <SkillValue>% slower than usual. Capable of controlling <N> probes.

sTrader.Name: Commerce Skill
sTrader.Text: The pilot can sell equipment and weapons for <SkillValue>% of actual cost. The goods' sale price is <SkillValue2>% closer to the best price.
